# @sokkay/react-gantt — LLM / agent context

> Ship this file with the npm package. In a consumer project, read:
> `node_modules/@sokkay/react-gantt/llms.txt`
> and `node_modules/@sokkay/react-gantt/dist/index.d.ts`
> before inventing props or callbacks.

## What this is

Controlled React 18+ Gantt chart. The library emits callbacks; the host owns
`projects`, selection, collapse, column widths, and any sort order.

```tsx
import { GanttChart } from "@sokkay/react-gantt";
import "@sokkay/react-gantt/styles.css";
```

Peers: `react` and `react-dom` `>=18 <20`.

## Invariants

- Controlled component: never assume internal persistence of `projects`.
- Dates accept `Date | string | number`; internals normalize to start-of-day.
- Timeline modes: `day` | `week` | `month` | `quarter` | `year`.
- Weeks use `weekStartsOn: 1`.
- Styles ship as importable CSS (`@sokkay/react-gantt/styles.css`).
- Public class names use the `sokkay-gantt__*` prefix; treat them as a
  customization surface.

## Sidebar columns (unified)

Prop: `columns?: GanttSidebarColumn[]`.

When `columns` is omitted, one tree column is created from `labels.projectHeader`.

| kind | Role |
|------|------|
| `tree` | Grip, collapse toggle, project/task label |
| `data` | Optional `renderProject` / `renderTask` values |

Order in the array = visual order. Put the tree column anywhere.

### Sorting (host-controlled)

There is no built-in column sort API. Put a control in `header` and reorder
`projects` (and nested `tasks`) in host state.

```tsx
columns={[
  {
    id: "project",
    kind: "tree",
    header: (
      <button type="button" onClick={() => toggleSort("name")}>
        Project {sortDir === "asc" ? "↑" : "↓"}
      </button>
    ),
  },
  {
    id: "start",
    kind: "data",
    header: (
      <button type="button" onClick={() => toggleSort("start")}>
        Start
      </button>
    ),
    width: 100,
    renderTask: (task) => task.start.toLocaleDateString(),
  },
]}
```

Resize: set `resizable: true` and update `width` from
`onSidebarColumnWidthChange` / `onSidebarColumnResizeEnd`.

## Core data

```ts
projects: Array<GanttProject<TProjectMeta, TTaskMeta>>
// project: { id, name, tasks, progress?, meta? }
// task: { id, projectId, name, start, end, segments?, progress?, color?, meta? }
```

Optional `task.segments[]` for non-contiguous ranges; each segment edits
independently. `showSegmentConnectors` draws dashed links between segments.

## Important props (grouped)

### View
`viewMode`, `minDate`, `maxDate`, `snapTo`, `customCellWidths`, `locale`,
`layoutMode` (`compact` | `tree`), `virtualized`, `overscan`

### Selection / collapse
`selectedTaskId`, `onTaskSelect`
`selectedRows`, `onRowSelectionChange`, `onRowContextMenu`
`collapsedProjectIds` / `defaultCollapsedProjectIds`, `onProjectCollapseChange`
`showProjectToggle` (`boolean` | `(project) => boolean`, default `true`) —
controls the expand/collapse button only. Projects with `tasks.length === 0`
never show it. Collapse state and imperative methods stay available either way.
`selectionToolbarMode`: `auto` | `static` | `hidden`

### Sidebar
`columns`, `sidebarWidth`, `minSidebarWidth`, `onSidebarWidthChange`
`onSidebarColumnWidthChange`, `onSidebarColumnResizeEnd`

### Interactions (payloads are named objects)
`onTaskMove` / `onTaskMoveEnd`
`onTaskResize` / `onTaskResizeEnd`
`onTaskTransfer`, `onTaskReorder`, `onProjectReorder`
`onTaskContextMenu`

### Render slots
`renderTask`, `renderTaskTooltip(task, { segment? })`
`renderContextMenu`, `renderSelectionToolbar`, `renderEmptySelectionToolbar`
`renderHeaderCell`, `renderTimelineCell`, `renderCollapsedProjectSummary`

Tree/data cell content belongs on `columns[].renderProject` / `renderTask`,
not on removed props (`renderProjectCell`, `renderSidebarHeader`,
`renderSidebarTaskCell`, `sidebarColumns`).

### Theming
`theme`, `classNames`, `labels`, `className`

## Imperative handle

```ts
const ref = useGanttChart();
ref.current?.scrollToDate(date)
ref.current?.scrollToTask(taskId)
ref.current?.selectTask(taskId | null)
ref.current?.collapseProject / expandProject / toggleProject(projectId)
```

## Anti-patterns

- Do not mutate `projects` inside the library mentally — always update host state
  from callbacks.
- Do not expect `apps/docs` or monorepo `AGENTS.md` to exist in npm installs.
- Do not invent props like `sortable` / `onSort` — sort is host-owned via headers.
- Do not require Tailwind in the consumer app.

## Source of truth in this package

- Types + JSDoc: `dist/index.d.ts` (from `src/types.ts`)
- This guide: `llms.txt`
- Human overview: `README.md`
- Migrations: `CHANGELOG.md`
